svg.title: ryu_yard site plan
svg.text: ryu_yard · Ryu Survey compound (+ ryu_practice_yard, ryu_yard_street, ryu_office, ryu_yard_roof, ryu_training_gate)
Site plan in metres, north up. Western Mangwon-dong (Mangwon 2-dong), Mapo-gu: about 12 minutes' walk west of Taeo's flat. Fictional, no real address.
The west practice yard follows the Codex key world/keys/ryu_practice_yard/; the east lot, the workshop roof and the cage are decided here from the scripts.
YARD STREET (ryu_yard_street): plane tree, parked scooters, low buildings, overhead wires
BACK LANE (vans in and out of the east lot)
